title: Level1Prediction
description: Result of a Level1Engine (ADR-0035): for each player on a Lage, the engine's predicted next move out of a closed set of move options, with the engine's own confidence and the ids of the on-board cards it used. An attributed estimate ('<engine> estimates ...'), never a verdict: it is not a card, does not count as a decision, does not trigger rules, does not enter statistics and is never shared (ADR-0036). `predictedMove` is one of `moveOptions` and every id in `cardIds` names a card of the request (checked by the conformance kit and the cross-check `level1-move`).

lageId.description: The Lage whose board the prediction is about.

requestHash.description: sha256:<hex> over the RFC 8785 serialisation of the request (ADR-0034). The board shows a prediction only while its request hash equals the hash of the current request; otherwise it is stale.

engineId.title: Level1EngineId
engineId.description: Engine id, e.g. local-rules, a local model, or an external decision service. Shown as '<engine> estimates ...' and used as the proposal author agent:<engine>.

moveOptions.title: Level1MoveOptions
moveOptions.description: The closed set of moves a player can make next: the enum of the engine's output schema for that player.

trigger.title: Level1Trigger
trigger.description: Why the engine ran. `assumption_changed`: the user placed, removed or edited an assumption card on the Lage (the what-if re-run; `cardIds` names the changed assumption cards). `lage_opened`: the Lage was opened. `manual`: the user asked.

allOf.description: An assumption change names the changed assumption cards.

playerRequest.title: Level1PlayerRequest
playerRequest.description: One player to predict: an actor card on the Lage and its move options.

request.title: Level1PredictionRequest
request.description: What a Level1Engine receives: the Lage, its question, the trigger, the players with their move options, and the gate-cleared canonical cards on the board (including the user's rule cards), nothing else. Never stance data. For a cloud_model engine `cards` are exactly the objects of one confirmed transfer (ADR-0031). Every playerCardId names a card in `cards` (cross-check `level1-players`).

playerPrediction.title: Level1PlayerPrediction
playerPrediction.description: The engine's estimate for one player: the predicted move (one of moveOptions), the engine's calibrated confidence for it, and the ids of the on-board cards it used (at least the player card).

confidence.description: The engine's own calibrated confidence for predictedMove, shown attributed to the engine. Not an ICD 203 estimate by a source (ADR-0010).

cardIds.description: Ids of the request cards the engine used.
